name: Regulatory clarity

subjectOf.text: Where SEC guidance failed, the failure was localized: respondents who found guidance inadequate pointed predominantly to Form PF Section 1c, Item B, which concerns information about the reporting fund.
subjectOf.abstract: The majority of the commenters who believed that SEC guidance was inadequate indicated that SEC guidance was particularly unclear with respect to Form PF Section 1c, Item B (regarding Reporting Funds).
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Private Fund Disclosures Under the Dodd-Frank Act (2014). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2447306
scope_conditions: respondents who rated SEC guidance inadequate

subjectOf.text: The core distinguishing features of blockchain technology are only generically definitional: they characterize the technology as a class but supply no specific definitions usable for classification.
subjectOf.abstract: The core distinguishing features of blockchain technology help define the technology generically but provide no specific definitions. For example, the technology's distributed consensus
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Securities Versus Utility Tokens (2022). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4021599
